scope: 24 natural public-input runs of two frozen simulation versions. Not the helper 1000-seed matrix, browser/performance, human fun, or retention evidence.

policy.precision: Exact saved activeInput; unchanged original run/modal/growth bytes.
policy.area: Only activeInput tool field changes to ready tool2, otherwise tool1; movement, aim, Q, priorities and public modal handling unchanged.
policy.publicMutationScope: Only saved start/step/discardDraft/chooseCombatUpgrade/resume. Observer writes only external records, never game state.
policy.outcomePolicy: No forced victory, damage, adaptation difference or failure. All real deaths, timeouts and measurement errors retained; no seed swaps or retries.
policy.beforeWave20Definition: Hash inputs evaluated while the pre-step wave<20, including the boundary-advancing step; compare versions within the same seed and policy only.
policy.probabilityDefinition: At most55% for a newly drawn main, not marginal inclusion of a retained companion.

baseline/precision.observer: Read-only GameSession subclass observes before/after public step and public bus; original run and public choice code retained byte-for-byte.

baseline/area.onlyPolicyChange: tool2 while its published cooldown is ready, otherwise tool1
